sale.search: Search name, SKU or scan a barcode
sale.noMatch: Nothing matches “{{query}}”. Check the code or search by name.
sale.errorText: Check your connection and try again.
sale.emptySale: Scan or tap a product to start a sale.
sale.fixStock: Fix the quantities marked in red to charge.
sale.clearText: Everything in the basket and the customer are removed.
sale.onlyLeft: Only {{count}} left at {{branch}}. Lower the quantity or remove it.
sale.noneLeft: None left at {{branch}}. Remove it, or ask a manager to correct the stock.

discount.title: Apply discount
discount.reasonHint: Saved with the sale and shown in reports.
discount.limit: Your role allows discounts up to {{max}}%. Larger discounts aren’t shown.

customer.title: Add customer
customer.hint: Type their phone number and press Enter. Walk-in sales don’t need a customer.
customer.lookupFailed: We couldn’t search customers. Check your connection and try again.
customer.notFound: No customer with this number. Add them now, or skip — walk-in sales don’t need a customer.
customer.saveFailed: We couldn’t save the customer. Check your connection and try again.

errors.phoneTaken: Another customer already has this phone number.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.errorTitle: We couldn’t load the payment methods
checkout.errorText: Check your connection and try again.
checkout.keepOpen: Keep this screen open. Buttons are locked so the payment isn’t recorded twice.
checkout.recoveryText: This payment is saved. The sale is still being completed, so the receipt isn’t ready yet.
checkout.recoveryTextMany: Both payments are saved. The sale is still being completed, so the receipt isn’t ready yet.
checkout.dontCollect: Don’t take payment again. The customer has already paid {{amount}} EGP.
checkout.partlyText: {{paid}} EGP is recorded. Collect the remaining {{left}} EGP.
checkout.payFailed: We couldn’t record the payment. Nothing was saved — check your connection and try again.
checkout.shortBy: {{amount}} EGP short. Record it and pay the rest another way, or enter more.

takeFirst.card: Take the payment on your card machine first. Record it here only after the machine shows it was approved.
takeFirst.wallet: Take the payment in the wallet app first. Record it here only after it shows it was approved.
takeFirst.cash: Take the payment first. Record it here only after it shows it was approved.

checkout.neverCard: Vendora never asks for the card number, expiry date or CVV.

errors.amountMax: Can’t be more than what’s left ({{left}}). Cash is the only method that gives change.

done.errorText: Check your connection and try again.
done.title: Sale complete
done.attentionText: The payment is recorded, but the receipt couldn’t be issued yet. This isn’t a completed sale until the receipt is issued.
done.safe: Payment of {{amount}} EGP is safe. Don’t collect it again.
done.retryFailed: Still not issued. Try again in a moment.
done.attentionNote: If you start a new sale, this one stays in Sales marked “needs attention” so a manager can finish it.

reprint.errorText: Check your connection and try again.
reprint.title: Receipt {{number}}
reprint.aboutText: A reprint is an exact copy of the receipt issued at the time of sale. It’s marked as a copy and never changes prices, payments or the receipt number.
